gloss_en: Joseph (Yosef), the biblical patriarch son of Jacob, as the archetype of the tzaddik who guards the covenant (shmirat/tikkun ha-brit) — associated in Likutey Moharan with peace (shalom), sexual holiness, mesirat nefesh, uniting mind and speech, and 'adding' (from the root y-s-f, per Gen 30:24); NOT the plain verb יוֹסִיף 'he will add'
